artworks.title: Les deux perroquets, le roi et son fils (Two Parrots, the King, and His Son)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: This painting depicts a classical architectural scene with a bird and multiple individuals. It is done in the style of Jean-Baptiste Oudry. The image includes a large building with stone columns and stairs. A parrot is perched on a tree, catching attention with its colorful feathers. In the foreground, a person in classical clothing appears to be in motion. In the background, a group of people are gathered with varied expressions and gestures directed towards the person in the foreground. The architectural elements and foliage add depth and context to the scene.

artworks.title: Le renard et les poulets d'Inde (The Fox and the Hens from India)
artworks.artist: Pierre François Tardieu after Jean-Baptiste Oudry
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: This image shows a brown fox and turkeys near a rustic house. The fox is looking at turkeys perched on tree branches. The setting includes a wooden fence, an old stone building with a red roof, and a full moon in the sky. Two turkeys are on the ground near the fox. The painting style resembles the detailed illustrations of the 18th century, similar to Jean-Baptiste Oudry's work.

artworks.title: Le loup et le renard (The Wolf and the Fox)
artworks.artist: Pierre François Tardieu after Jean-Baptiste Oudry
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic and natural landscape with a wolf and a fox near a rooster. A fence curves towards a river dividing the scene. The horizon is defined by the river and opposite land. The brushstrokes are fine and detailed, creating texture. The color palette includes muted earth tones, greens, blues, and pastel hues for the sky. In the distance, a rural dwelling with a red roof is surrounded by trees and a mountain.

artworks.title: Le vieux chat et la jeune Souris (The Old Catand the Young Mouse)
artworks.artist: Johann Christoph Teucher after Jean-Baptiste Oudry
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cat with a mouse in its mouth in front of a thatched cottage. The scene includes a detailed drawing of a rustic cottage made of bricks with a thatched roof. Smoke rises from a chimney, beside a large tree and a brook flowing on the left. The cat is holding the mouse, showing a moment of action. The color palette consists of muted tones of brown, green, and gray.

artworks.title: La querelle des chiens et des chats et celle des chats et des souris (The Quarrel of Cats and Dogs, and that of Cats and Mice)
artworks.artist: Johann Christoph Teucher after Jean-Baptiste Oudry
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: Two large cats are in an attic space, each holding a mouse. The color palette includes browns, grays, beiges, blues, and reds. The cats are on the floor facing left. Some books and a chest are on the left side, and a window shows rooftops and a chimney under a cloudy sky. The attic has exposed beams sloping down from the peaked roof.

artworks.title: The Mill-Wheel
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up view of dense foliage with tree trunks on the left side, extending into intricate branches. The horizon is not clearly defined, with natural elements dominating the view. A rustic stone structure is subtly visible in the middle. The fine lines create rich textures, depicting the roughness of the trees and stones. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones, giving it an aged appearance. In the distance, the structure is detailed with cross-hatched lines, adding depth and complexity.

artworks.title: Falconeer Lifting an Owl from the Ground
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: The image shows a man on a horse with a distant view of trees and buildings. The man extends his arm downward towards an owl in motion. Birds are seen flying in the sky. The artwork features detailed line work in grayscale tones, depicting a cloudy sky in the background.

artworks.title: Huntsman with a Pack of Hounds
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. George W. Ware
artworks.description: The image shows a man riding a horse. He is upright in the saddle facing the right side of the image, guiding the horse. He has a prominent nose and a moustache. He wears a tricorn hat, a tailored coat, breeches, and knee-high boots. A hunting horn is slung across his chest. Around him are hunting dogs moving in the same direction. The background features a dense forest with tall leafy trees, a grassy clearing, and a textured sky.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. David Tunick
artworks.description: The image shows two main figures. On the left, a seated woman with long hair is portrayed, wearing a flowing garment. On the right, a winged angelic figure is kneeling, holding a bouquet of flowers. Around them are clouds, cherubic angels, and a central radiating dove. The background features detailed cloudwork, and there are texts and a basket with fabric or textiles at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Purple Martin (Hirundo purpurea)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows a dark blue bird on a wooden structure, with green leaves and red berries. The color palette includes dark blues, bright greens, rich reds, and natural wood tones. The bird is positioned on a horizontal stick.

artworks.title: Landscape with Trees
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Eleanor Whittlesey Kotz Savorgnan
artworks.description: The image shows a natural landscape with a row of trees at the horizon. Brushstrokes are broad and textured. The color palette is monochromatic with black, gray, and white hues. Grass and the land rise towards the horizon, and the sky displays swirling patterns.

artworks.title: Blue Spring, Florida
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth K. Henschel in memory of her husband, Charles R. Henschel
artworks.description: This painting shows a view of a calm body of water with greenery surrounding it. Across the water appears to be a hill or shore that slopes upward to the top of the painting, painted in gray and cream tones and covered in palm-like plants in shades of green, brown, and rusty red. A similar plant is visible near the bottom right corner in a dark shade of yellow. The water in the center is painted in shades of blue with some ripples across the top. The brushstrokes are fluid.

artworks.title: Casting, Number Two
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth K. Henschel in memory of her husband, Charles R. Henschel
artworks.description: This painting shows a person fishing in a small blue-gray boat, situated to the left of center. The individual's back is to us, and they hold a fishing rod that extends from the center of the painting into the water on the far right. The person is wearing a tan shirt, tan pants with a brown belt, and a wide-brimmed tan hat. There are thick, dark green and blue trees in the background; the water reflects dark greens and blues, as well as shades of tan and white from the boat and person. The brushstrokes are loose, and different colors of paint blend softly with one another.

artworks.title: The Coming Storm
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth K. Henschel in memory of her husband, Charles R. Henschel
artworks.description: Charcoal-gray clouds fill most of the sky over a turquoise-blue body of water in this horizontal watercolor painting. The gray clouds on the left become more blue as they move to the right. The water is framed by low hills sloping down from both sides, which are painted in cinnamon and dark brown with touches of forest green and topped with a few slender, windblown trees. Several black rocks form a curve along the lower right side of a cove directly in front of us. Loose strokes of brown, tan, and pale blue fill the lower right corner below them. On the horizon, at the center of the composition, is a dark gray finger of land with a tiny steamship drifting by, smoke rising from its two smokestacks. The artist signed and dated the lower left, “Homer 1901.”

artworks.title: Girl Carrying a Basket
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth K. Henschel in memory of her husband, Charles R. Henschel
artworks.description: A young woman with light skin carries a large basket propped on her hip down a steep dune in this horizontal watercolor, which is painted mostly in light slate blue, sage green, tan, and ivory white. She is near the top of the hill, to our left. Her reddish-brown hair is pulled back to the nape of her neck. She wears a long, steel-blue dress with the sleeves rolled up to her elbows and black clog-like shoes. The hill she stands on angles steeply down from almost the top left corner of the paper to just inside the lower right corner, and it is dotted with scrubby green grasses on sand-colored ground. The horizon line is very low, nearly along the bottom edge of the composition. In the deep distance, beyond the dune in the lower right corner, a small patch of blue water with a single sailboat is visible. The bright, hazy sky is nearly white.

artworks.title: A Good Shot, Adirondacks
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth K. Henschel in memory of her husband, Charles R. Henschel
artworks.description: A buck jerks to the right as it leaps toward us, over a boulder and away from a rolling river in this horizontal watercolor painting. The buck is just right of center, and his body scissors, presumably as a gunshot lands. His curling horns nearly meet in an oval overhead, and one front leg is pulled up. The river is painted with tones of spruce green and sapphire, topaz, and celestial blue. The black silhouettes of two animals, either more deer or dogs, are in the distance to the right, and a white puff is along the far bank to the left. The forested background is painted broadly with tones of earthy green, tan, and smoky blue. The artist signed and dated the watercolor in the lower left corner, “Oct 12 1892 Homer.”

artworks.title: Hauling in the Nets
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth K. Henschel in memory of her husband, Charles R. Henschel
artworks.description: This painting shows two fishermen in a small red boat on the ocean. The fishermen appear to be pulling up two large nets that have been cast over either side of the boat, and they are looking to the left. They wear clothing in shades of blue and brown and large hats with wide brims. Their facial features are not visible, but they have peach-toned skin. There appears to be a round barrel in the back of the boat behind the two fishermen. The water around the red boat is filled with low waves painted in shades of blue and gray. The sky above is painted in similar shades, with the dark outlines of a few birds flying by. The horizon line is about halfway up the painting, and the brushstrokes are visible and fluid.

artworks.title: Sketch for "Hound and Hunter"
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth K. Henschel in memory of her husband, Charles R. Henschel
artworks.description: This painting shows a person in a small boat on a body of water. The person is all the way on one end of the boat, leaning towards the right and reaching out over the side of the boat, holding a rope that appears to be tied to the white antlers of a large brown deer that is almost completely submerged in the water. A black-and-white dog swims in the water behind the deer. The person has pale skin and short brown hair, and they are wearing a black hat and a gray coat. The boat is gray-brown, and the water below is painted with lines of blue, white, green, and teal. The background is a mix of dark gray and olive green.

artworks.title: Incoming Tide, Scarboro, Maine
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth K. Henschel in memory of her husband, Charles R. Henschel
artworks.description: This painting shows a seascape with brown and gray rocks across the bottom, partially submerged in the water. The sky is gray and the dark blue sea is turbulent, with waves crashing up against the rocks in a spray of white and light blue-green. The colors are soft and blend into one another.

artworks.title: Key West, Hauling Anchor
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth K. Henschel in memory of her husband, Charles R. Henschel
artworks.description: A white boat with sails lowered floats in an aquamarine-blue ocean under a pale, sapphire-blue sky in this horizontal watercolor painting. To our right of center, the boat floats with its right, starboard side facing us and the bow angled slightly away. The white sails bunch up under the lowered, horizontal booms just above the top of the boat. The masts and rigging extend off the top of the composition. A group of a few people are gathered in the bow, on the far side of the sails. They are painted loosely but appear to have brown skin and red or black clothing. Waves lap against the side of the boat. To our left, an island or sliver of land with three palm trees deep in the distance lines the horizon, which comes about a third of the way up the composition. The water and sky are painted with layers of pale washes. The artist signed and dated the work in the lower left corner with dark paint: “HOMER KEY WEST 1903.”

artworks.title: The Lone Fisherman
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth K. Henschel in memory of her husband, Charles R. Henschel
artworks.description: This painting shows a person in a canoe on a lake, with the horizon marked by a line of dense trees. The person in the canoe has pale skin and wears a light shirt, but their facial features are indistinct. The loose, fluid painting style features soft brushstrokes and a color palette of dark green, dark blue, pale blue, and white. The water reflects the dark trees and parts of the cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Milk Maid
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth K. Henschel in memory of her husband, Charles R. Henschel
artworks.description: A pale-skinned young woman stands facing our right on a grassy hillside also occupied by two cows, a rooster, and a chicken in this vertical watercolor. The palette is dominated with olive, forest, and sage green with touches of mauve pink, brown, and black. The woman’s body is angled slightly toward us, but her head turns away so we see her in profile. She wears a long, pale mauve-pink dress with a charcoal-gray and rust-brown scarf draped over her shoulders. White stockings and brown shoes peek out from under the ankle-length hem. A boxy, pale pink form, perhaps a bonnet, hangs down her back from a slender ribbon around the front of her neck. Her arms rest at her sides as she holds a small wooden stool in one hand and the handle of a wooden pail in the other. Just in front of her feet, a caramel-brown chicken pecks at the ground as the rooster, with a flounce of black tail feathers, looks alertly into the distance. The cluster of trees in the near distance beyond the young woman nearly fill the rest of the scene with their leafy canopies. Two cows are under the trees, one to either side of the woman. A chocolate-brown cow with a white face lies down on the left, while a ginger-brown cow stands on the right. Sunlight peeks in through a few gaps in the leaves. A portion of a distant slate-blue mountain and patch of pale peach sky are visible over the cow’s head in the lower left. The artist signed and dated the lower left, “HOMER 1878.”

artworks.title: On the Trail
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth K. Henschel in memory of her husband, Charles R. Henschel
artworks.description: This painting shows a densely wooded area with autumn foliage in shades of light and dark green, rusty orange, and yellow ochre among blue-gray trunks. A man dressed in brown tones and a hat stands looking off to the right, facing away from us. With him are two dogs with spots of white, brown, and black. The colors of the forest have been painted in fluid strokes and small dots, and they overlap with one another, creating depth.

artworks.title: Red Shirt, Homosassa, Florida
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth K. Henschel in memory of her husband, Charles R. Henschel
artworks.description: This painting shows a landscape with tall palm trees and bright green ferns by a body of water. In the background is a dense, dark forest in shades of black and dark blue. Closest to us, light blue water flows horizontally across the painting. In the bottom left corner, there is a long gray canoe that appears to have a person sitting in it, wearing red and holding a long white fishing line. The color palette includes shades of green for the trees and soft blue, white, and grey for the sky. The brushstrokes in the painting are loose and expressive, allowing colors to overlap and blend together.
